#WxHistory |
#OTDwx: Typhoon Gaemi '24 (Carina) made landfall in Taiwan with blunt impact. The Philippines & China were greatly impacted as well. The C4 typhoon caused devastating flooding for those 3 areas. In Yonaguni, Japan, a wind gust of 110mph (180kph) was recorded. In 🇹🇼, 20.19in (513mm) of rain was recorded in Luoyuan County. 
Overall, Gaemi killed 152-194 w/ a damage toll up to $4.6B USD. North Korea had reported a death toll into the thousands but that remains disputed. 
For whatever strange reason, both Gaemi & Carina weren't retired & now stay on the list.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 60 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Typhoon EMONG
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 25 July 2025(Friday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac, Pampanga, Bulacan, Metro Manila, Rizal, Laguna, Cavite and Batangas.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Quezon within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
